wrong.why: Judah in מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה denotes the kingdom Hezekiah ruled, not the person recorded as judah.

missing.why: The verse calls David Hezekiah's father (דָוִד אָבִיו) in the ancestral sense, while verse 1 names Ahaz as his father.

note: All other explicit family statements are already recorded here or in the supplied rows from other chapters.
